la-orleans-2026-cdc-divl-mckenna-warren.name: Warren McKenna, III
la-orleans-2026-cdc-divl-mckenna-warren.bio: Attorney of nearly 30 years in civil litigation, private practice and public service; former Judge Pro Tempore and leader with Southeast Louisiana Legal Services.

la-orleans-2026-cdc-divl-newell-candace.name: Candace N. Newell
la-orleans-2026-cdc-divl-newell-candace.bio: Attorney serving as Of Counsel at Daly & Black, P.C., state representative for Louisiana House District 99, and former teacher.

la-orleans-2026-cdc-divm-lindsay-shawn.name: Shawn Lindsay
la-orleans-2026-cdc-divm-lindsay-shawn.bio: Deputy City Attorney for New Orleans who has defended the city in court since 2004.

la-orleans-2026-cdc-dom1-hall-michael.name: Michael "Mike" Hall
la-orleans-2026-cdc-dom1-hall-michael.bio: Founder and managing attorney of the Law Office of Michael J. Hall.

la-orleans-2026-crim-secd-levine-simone.name: Simone Levine
la-orleans-2026-crim-secd-levine-simone.bio: Judge of Orleans Parish Criminal District Court, Section A; former Court Watch NOLA executive director, Deputy Police Monitor, prosecutor and criminal defense attorney.

la-orleans-2026-crim-sech-buras-camille.name: Camille Buras
la-orleans-2026-crim-sech-buras-camille.bio: Judge of Orleans Parish Criminal District Court, Section H, for 28 years.

la-orleans-2026-crim-sech-roche-leon.name: Leon Roché
la-orleans-2026-crim-sech-roche-leon.bio: Judge of Orleans Parish Criminal District Court since 2023; previously founded the Leon T. Roché II Law Firm.

la-orleans-2026-magistrate-debose-chanel.name: Chanel Robinson Debose
la-orleans-2026-magistrate-debose-chanel.bio: Attorney with 27 years of experience in criminal, civil, and administrative law.

la-orleans-2026-magistrate-lombard-juana.name: Juana Marine Lombard
la-orleans-2026-magistrate-lombard-juana.bio: Magistrate Judge of Orleans Parish Criminal District Court since 2021; former public defender, capital defense attorney, and civil litigator.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-064-haymon-rho.name: Rhonda A. Haymon
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-064-haymon-rho.bio: Criminal defense attorney with the Los Angeles County Public Defender's Office, formerly with the Orange County Public Defender's Office, and adjunct professor at Southwestern Law School.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-064-ghobadi-ma.name: Maria Ghobadi
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-064-ghobadi-ma.bio: Los Angeles County Deputy District Attorney in the Gang Homicide Division; former Northern California prosecutor and State Bar Deputy Trial Attorney.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-065-reitano-an.name: Anna Slotky Reitano
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-065-reitano-an.bio: Deputy County Counsel in Los Angeles County's Justice and Safety Division; former Deputy Public Defender for more than a decade.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-065-clayton-ju.name: Justin Allen Clayton
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-065-clayton-ju.bio: Deputy in Charge of the Los Angeles County Public Defender's Office Inglewood branch; criminal defense attorney.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-087-dejute-dav.name: David DeJute
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-087-dejute-dav.bio: Attorney of more than three decades; former Assistant U.S. Attorney, Sony Pictures Entertainment litigation vice president, and Pepperdine Disaster Relief Clinic director.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-087-bayne-anth.name: Anthony (A.J.) Bayne
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-087-bayne-anth.bio: Deputy public defender with over 26 years of service handling serious felony cases.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-131-tryfman-do.name: Donna Tryfman
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-131-tryfman-do.bio: Los Angeles County Deputy Public Defender in the Major Cases Unit; former Public Defenders Association president and Judge Pro Tem.

ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-131-ross-david.name: David Ross
ca-los-angeles-2026-judge-131-ross-david.bio: Los Angeles County Deputy Alternate Public Defender; former television journalist and Judge Pro Tem.

ca-riverside-2026-judge-010-paradise-mic.name: Michelle Paradise
ca-riverside-2026-judge-010-paradise-mic.bio: Former Riverside County Assistant District Attorney and Assistant County Executive Officer for Public Safety.

ca-riverside-2026-judge-010-garcia-andre.name: Andrea Garcia
ca-riverside-2026-judge-010-garcia-andre.bio: Deputy public defender in San Bernardino County specializing in immigration law; former Riverside County public defender immigration specialist and private immigration attorney.

fl-duval-2026-county-judge-g13-buncome-m.name: Melina Buncome
fl-duval-2026-county-judge-g13-buncome-m.bio: Public defender in Florida's Fourth Judicial Circuit for nearly 30 years and former Felony Division Chief.

fl-duval-2026-county-judge-g13-holliday-.name: Octavius A. Holliday Jr.
fl-duval-2026-county-judge-g13-holliday-.bio: Prosecutor with the State Attorney's Office for the 4th Judicial Circuit since 2003, including as Director of the Human Rights Division and Community Crime Strategies Unit.

fl-miami-dade-2026-circuit-g5-mcneil-art.name: Arthur LeMar "Marty" McNeil
fl-miami-dade-2026-circuit-g5-mcneil-art.bio: Senior Supervising Attorney at the Miami-Dade Public Defender's Office; former sole-practitioner attorney.

fl-miami-dade-2026-circuit-g5-segura-mon.name: Monica Segura
fl-miami-dade-2026-circuit-g5-segura-mon.bio: Civil attorney working in-house for an insurance carrier; former Special Master/Magistrate for the Town of Miami Lakes.
